phase2_symbolic_execution.summary: Symbolic execution analysis for EIP-7883 multiplication complexity calculation ceiling division property. Analysis reveals that Prysm is a consensus layer (CL) client and does NOT implement EVM execution logic including precompiles. EIP-7883 is an execution layer (EL) specification that modifies the ModExp precompile gas calculation. Therefore, this property is OUT OF SCOPE for Prysm as it does not contain any implementation of the multiplication_complexity calculation function or any EVM precompiles.

phase2_5_reachability_analysis.notes: EIP-7883 is an execution layer specification that modifies the ModExp (0x05) precompile gas calculation. Prysm, as a consensus layer client, delegates all EVM execution (including precompile execution and gas calculations) to external execution layer clients through the Engine API. The multiplication_complexity calculation function specified in EIP-7883 would only be implemented in execution layer clients such as Geth (Go), Nethermind (C#), Besu (Java), Erigon (Go), or Reth (Rust). Audit focus for this property should be on execution layer client implementations, not consensus layer clients like Prysm.
